answer: A farm of 358 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in marble, queued in willow, and gale publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 100 identities per epoch. A farm of 3173 identities would post 1252 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
